optional_module_boundary.optical_attribution: Secondary only; may be disabled without invalidating an otherwise confirmatory optical primary.
optional_module_boundary.hydrodynamic: Separate module; not a prerequisite for this campaign.

current_decision: No outcome-bearing field collection is authorized yet. Resolve TNC-v2 pilot/geometry/preservation items, final four-bay node/calendar manifests, assay/preservation capacity, analysis-code freeze and optional-module intents before deployment.
claim_boundary: Readiness status is logistics/design evidence, not ecological evidence.
Do not populate resource fields from assumptions or inferred equipment availability.
If optional forcing capacity is insufficient, disable that module before collection rather than degrading the four-bay TNC primary.
Response-independent sensor and laboratory pilots remain allowed while the campaign is STOP_RESOURCE_FREEZE_INCOMPLETE.
